meta.name: formax-surface-reset-workflow
meta.description: Use when changing REPL clear/reset/resume/surface behavior (onClearTerminal, transcriptSeq remount, Ink Static paths, Ctrl+O/Ctrl+E transitions). Enforces single-owner reset transaction and prevents black-screen/flicker/duplicate-row regressions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 控制终端重置与恢复行为，防止黑屏闪烁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在REPL中管理终端重置和恢复流程
copy.tagline_en: Control terminal reset and resume behavior to prevent black screen flicker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage terminal reset and resume workflows in REPL

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在处理终端清除、重置、恢复或界面切换时，会强制使用单一所有者的重置流程，避免出现黑屏、闪烁或重复行等显示问题。
howto.when: 当你修改终端的清除、重置、恢复或界面切换相关代码时触发，例如涉及/resume、/clear命令或Ctrl+O/Ctrl+E切换等。

say.text: 调整终端清除逻辑，不要出现黑屏。
在Ctrl+O切换界面时防止闪烁。
say.note: 技能处理界面切换稳定性。

say.text: 修改/resume行为保持表面一致。

howto.what_en: This skill forces a single-owner reset transaction when modifying REPL clear, reset, resume, or surface transitions, preventing black-screen, flicker, or duplicate-row regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you change clear/reset/resume/surface behavior, such as /resume, /clear commands, Ctrl+O/Ctrl+E switches, or related code paths.

say_en.text: Adjust terminal clear logic, avoid black screen.
Prevent flicker when switching with Ctrl+O.
